title: Ramsey Number R(5,5)
exact_target: What is the smallest number of vertices that forces a monochromatic complete graph on five vertices in every red/blue edge coloring?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1492 (COMB-005). CC BY 4.0.
Vigleik Angeltveit and Brendan D. McKay, \emph{R(5,5) $\le46$}, Journal of Graph Theory 112 (2026), 198--208; arXiv:2409.15709v2, Section 1, definition and Theorem 1.1.
